title: Can We Trust AI Agents? A Case Study of an LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Ethical AI
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to the study of AI ethics and how LLM-based systems can be used to operationalize ethical principles in software development. It features a specialized 'AI Ethicist' agent and evaluates the prototype's ability to identify and address ethical themes such as bias, transparency, accountability, and regulatory compliance.
